propositions: test_contended_index_lock_cleared_during_backoff_succeeds fails intermittently on macOS py3.13 CI with error 'fatal: unable to write new index file' due to a wall-clock timer deleting git's real index.lock mid-commit

the test plants a young index.lock and arms a threading.Timer to delete it; under force_reclaim=True the planted lock is removed on first retry, then git's own real lock is created and deleted by the timer before git commit completes
the test's timer-based lock release has no identity check to distinguish the planted lock from git's own lock, causing deletion of a lock held by the code under test on slow runners
replacing threading.Timer with gitutil._retry_probe allows the test to release the planted lock deterministically after the first failure without risking deletion of git's legitimate locks
the production code path behaves correctly; the issue is test-local and caused by the test infrastructure, not a store or backoff defect
